The story was decent enough if you looked past the fact that you never talk (its always just your head bobbing and arms moving) and that it had almost no depth to the missions. The PVP is basically the underpowered feds VS an almost all cloaky enemy who can wipe out an entire team in less than five minutes. In the begining i would have gave this a recommendation but now it has become every other PTW kind of game. I do however give the ships a thumbs up as most are from the movies and shows. Of course I expect a lot of negative comments and thumbs down from people but if you played back then you would understand better. My over all rating would a 6.5/10.

text: I would give this game a 5/10 but since there's not a "meh" option for Steam reviews I'll go with a recommendation. This game does have its flaws. But once you get into the game, it evokes memories of the Playstation 2: Lord of the Rings the Two Towers and Return of the King games in that you control characters through a sort of gauntlet from one end of the map to the other, racking up kills as you go. The graphics are very close to the CGI animation of the Clone Wars TV Series and has all of the original actors. There are moments where you feel like you're watching an episode of the Clone Wars. That said there are some annoyingly frustrating sections where due to camera angles you end up missing jumps for small platforming areas and falling straight down a bottomless pit. The bugs mentioned above and this issue are the biggest obsticals for this game.

title: star wars™: the clone wars - republic heroes™
text: The Good- If you like the show and simple casual gaming the game is great, especially if you have kids who like the show.  For all intents and purposes this IS the show, it has the same voice actors, including the narrator, and looks EXACTLY like the show.  I was really impressed with how true to the show they stayed,  I don't think a more direct TV/Movie to game translation exists.   They also have currency/point system to buy cosmetic or combat upgrades,  Anakin in Cad Bane's hat made me crack up. The Bad- This WILL be a struggle for some people especially if you don't like platform gaming or a fixed camera.-  You cannot control the camera angles and this caused an enormous amount of frustration when trying to jump gaps at the proper angle.   I beat the first level in less than eight minutes, I then spent, what felt like hours but close to one, trying just to land on a disappearing droid to cross a gap; which ahsoka could manage in one hop, but anakin couldn't?   I have not been that frustrated with a game since mario 64 came out.  From research it appears to be an issue that only affects few people.  Beyond that it is more directed towards kids, meaning very simple gameplay and it can become repetative if you are used to more complex gaming. Personally I liked it because it was a good story/general extension to the show despite some frustrations, which lets face it, is not an uncommon thing in games.  Bought in the star wars bundle when it was on sale, would recommend waiting for a sale to buy because it might not be worth the $20 price tag for all users,  probably a decent deal for people with kids.

text: From what I've noticed, a lot of the unfavorable reviews for this game seem to revolve around how it compares to its early access days. title: starbound
text: Very good game but feels like it's missing something. Has a cool Minecraft survival feel, also space exploration and ship upgrading are cool features. Boss fights are solid and fun. Survival is not the whole basis of the game but I spent a good hour learning the game and another 2 hours trying to get off the first planet. Once you fix your ship  and acquire fuel, space exploration feels pretty fun. Fuel is a little of a burden to get, but  when you get a abundance of it you are pretty much set. Has ok survival game elements. Multiplayer is very exciting, but you have to join servers if you don't want to set up a server. I recommend the iLoveBacons server (Website: ) Otherwise Starbound has great customization as long as you know how to code. Some examples are custom armor, songs , and weapons. Overall, great game 7.5 out of 10 good game to play with friends.

title: starbound
text: I beat the game in 45 hours, first 30 of which i spent building a cool base never to visit again. The only seemingly redeeming quality is slightly more interesting exploration then in similar titles, but it gets stale pretty fast considering after visiting about 6 planets i started seeing often repeats of assets (whole buildings/cavern layouts exactly copied). Everything else, especially bossfights were inferior versions of Terraria. If I played this before Terraria maybe it would have been ok, but comparison between the two shows that Starbound simply offers less for more money.
